name: cx-box
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) is the goal of reaching the exit. Response(at_exit, holding_box) carries the box to the exit, and because at_exit holds only on the last step it requires holding_box on that step, which is what the task asks. Response(box_fell, holding_box) matches "whenever the box falls, pick it up again" with no preference cue, so it is hard. No clause adds an unstated requirement, and the pickup needed for the carry is already forced by the finishing conditions.

texts: Whenever the agent reaches the exit, the box must be in the agent's hands at that point, so the box is carried to the exit.
Whenever the box falls, the agent must pick it up again, so holding_box holds at that step or later.
